_comment: Drop-in tasks for the consumer project's .vscode/tasks.json.
The first task reformats the current file. The second runs the
format task and then reverts the editor's in-memory buffer so
the on-disk formatted version is reloaded — without the revert,
VSCode would overwrite the formatted file on next save with
keybindings-template.json): Ctrl+Alt+S triggers the second task.

tasks.label: Format Java file to Senzing standards
Format and reload Java file (Senzing standards)
dependsOn: Format Java file to Senzing standards
